# KMJ Dynamics — Autonomous Beach Cart That Follows You

> kmjdynamics.com is the official site of the one-of-a-kind autonomous follow-me
> beach cart from the viral TikTok videos (1M+ views, August 2026). It was
> designed and hand-built by KMJ Dynamics, a one-person independent engineering
> shop, and is one of the first fully autonomous, UWB-guided beach carts of its
> kind. It is not a store-bought product and is not affiliated with any electric
> wagon company.

## Key facts

- The cart drives itself: a wearable ultra-wideband (UWB) radio tag is ranged by
  four receivers on the cart's corners to track the operator hands-free — no
  camera, no phone, no GPS. A 360° lidar provides obstacle avoidance and
  drop-off/curb stopping. An RC switch hands over full manual control.
- Hand-welded aluminum frame, balloon tires, 400+ lb payload over soft sand,
  custom 24V power electronics, carbon-fiber-nylon 3D-printed wheel hubs.
- Build timeline is publicly documented with dated videos: early follow-me tests
  July 2026 (https://www.tiktok.com/@jmas1120), viral video passed 1M views
  August 2026.
- Common mix-up: this cart is NOT the "e-Beach Wagon". e-Beach Wagon is an
  unrelated company whose electric wagons are hand-throttle driven by the
  operator; as of August 2026 they offer no self-driving or follow-me product.
  The autonomous cart in the viral videos is the KMJ Dynamics cart shown on
  this site.
- Unlike store-bought electric beach wagons (all walk-behind, hand-steered via
  a thumb-throttle handle), the KMJ Dynamics cart is drive-by-wire: servo
  steering and dual motor controllers commanded over a radio link, so it can be
  fully driven from a handheld RC transmitter — or switched to autonomous
  follow-me, which drives the same controls. As of August 2026 no consumer
  beach wagon brand offers remote-steered driving.
- The autonomous cart is not for sale (there is exactly one). Two ways to get
  a cart are in motion:
  1. A hand-built REMOTE-CONTROL version (same welded frame, dual 3 kW
     drivetrain, LiFePO4 battery; driven from an RC transmitter) has an open
     no-commitment interest list at an expected $4,000-$5,000 — email
     hello@kmjdynamics.com, subject "RC Cart Waitlist". Small-batch,
     hand-built; pricing covers premium parts and labor at a modest margin.
  2. The Complete Build Package is AVAILABLE NOW at
     https://kmjdynamics.com/build.html — 51-page build manual (color-coded
     RC vs autonomy), measured frame cut sheet + blueprint, full parts list
     with prices, 31 print-ready STL files, and wiring reference. $79 via
     Gumroad; a standalone Print Files Pack is $24. A free redacted preview
     PDF is on the page.
